title: A point inside a shoulder
voice: Ib lub hau xub ua pob zeb me dua ib tug ntiv tes tau nyob hauv ib tug txiv neej lub xub pwg ntev tshaj tsib txhiab xyoo. Qhov me me ntawd hloov peb txoj kev to taub txog nws. Tus txiv neej tau nce mus rau saum tej roob siab. Nws nqa zaub mov thiab cuab yeej, tiam sis nws sab tes xis twb raug mob lawm. Muaj ib tug neeg tua xub tuaj tom nws nraub qaum. Tom qab ntawd muaj dab tsi tshwm sim? Peb muaj peev xwm tshawb nrhiav nws txoj kev taug zaum kawg, tab sis peb yuav tsum cais yam paub tseeb ntawm yam peb xav tias tej zaum muaj. Niaj hnub no peb hu nws ua Oetzi. Peb tsis paub nws lub npe tiag, tsis paub vim li cas nws nce roob, thiab tsis paub tus neeg uas tua nws. Cov pov thawj yog nws lub cev, zaub mov hauv plab, tej cuab yeej thiab tej yam me me uas yuav tsum siv tshuab tsom thiaj pom. Txhua yam qhia ib feem ntawm lub sij hawm xwb. Peb yuav muab tej feem ntawd los sib txuas yam tsis txhob hais tias peb paub txhua yam. Zaj no pib dua rau hnub kaum cuaj lub cuaj hlis xyoo ib txhiab cuaj puas cuaj caum ib. Ob tug neeg taug kev saum roob pom ib lub cev tawm hauv dej khov, ze ciam teb ntawm teb chaws Ltalis thiab Austria. Thaum xub thawj sawv daws xav tias yog ib tug neeg nyuam qhuav raug xwm txheej saum roob. Thaum muab lub cev tawm, lawv tseem tsis paub tias yog yam qub heev, ces qee qhov raug puas. Tom qab ntawd rab taus tooj liab, txoj hlua cog thiab cov khaub ncaws ua rau cov kws tshawb fawb xav dua. Kev ntsuas hnub nyoog qhia tias nws nyob thaum tiam neeg siv tooj liab, kwv yees peb txhiab peb puas xyoo ua ntej peb lub caij suav xyoo. Dej khov khaws tau ib tug neeg tiag thiab tej pov thawj ntawm nws lub neej.
source_voice: A stone point, smaller than a finger, remained inside a man's shoulder for more than five thousand years. It changed his story. The man had climbed into the Alps carrying food, tools, and a wounded hand. Someone shot him from behind. What happened next? We can investigate his final journey. But the closer we look, the more important one question becomes: which parts can we actually know? His modern name is Ötzi. His own name, his reasons for travelling, and the identity of the person who attacked him remain unknown. This is a reconstruction built from a body, a meal, damaged equipment, and microscopic traces. Each clue has a different kind of clock. Our task is to put those clocks together without pretending they all tell the same time, or turning a possibility into a memory. The modern story begins on September nineteenth, nineteen ninety-one. Two hikers noticed a body emerging from ice near the border of Italy and Austria. At first, a recent mountain accident seemed plausible. Recovering ancient evidence was not the original plan, and the earliest rescue attempts caused damage. Then the objects changed the question. A copper axe, plant-fibre cord, and unfamiliar clothing belonged to a world far older than expected. Radiocarbon dating placed him in the Copper Age, roughly around thirty-three hundred BCE. The ice had preserved a person, not an anonymous legend.

title: A traveller in the Copper Age
voice: Oetzi yog ib tug txiv neej laus, tej zaum muaj hnub nyoog plaub caug xyoo rov saud. Nws lub cev khaws tau ntau yam uas ib txwm yuav ploj mus. Tab sis thaum lub cev qhuav thiab raug nias hauv dej khov, nws kuj hloov lawm. Cov kws tshawb fawb yuav tsum cais qhov raug mob thaum tseem ciaj sia ntawm qhov puas tom qab tuag thiab thaum muab lub cev tawm. Qhov chaw pom nws nyob siab tshaj peb txhiab mev saum npoo hiav txwv. Yog thaj chaw Tisenjoch hauv roob Alps. Ciam teb niaj hnub no pab qhia qhov chaw xwb; tsis qhia tias nws yog neeg lub teb chaws twg. Thaum nws nyob, cov teb chaws niaj hnub no tseem tsis tau muaj. Hauv tej hav hauv qab roob muaj zej zog cog qoob loo, yug tsiaj thiab ua cuab yeej. Lawv kuj sib txuas nrog lwm zej zog hla tej kev nyuaj. Tej khoom uas Oetzi nqa qhia txog kev txawj ntse ntawm cov neeg ntawd. Nws txoj kev taug txuas tej hav nrog saum roob, tiam sis tsis qhia meej vim li cas nws yuav hla. Puas yog nws khiav ib qho teeb meem, mus ntsib lwm zej zog, los yog tab tom ua ib yam dab tsi li niaj zaus? Tej khoom xwb teb tsis tau. Peb pib ntawm tej nroj tsuag. Thaum ib tug neeg nce siab zuj zus, tej ntoo thiab nroj tsuag nyob ib ncig hloov. Hmoov paj me me muaj peev xwm nkag rau hauv zaub mov thiab dej. Cov kws paub tshuaj xyuas lawv daim duab hauv tshuab tsom thiaj paub tias yog hom nroj tsuag twg. Tab sis hmoov paj tsis yog cuab yeej qhia qhov chaw ib tug neeg nyob. Cua nqa tau nws mus deb. Yuav to taub nws lub ntsiab, yuav tsum paub thaj chaw, kev loj hlob ntawm nroj tsuag thiab lwm yam pov thawj thiab.
source_voice: He was an adult man, probably in his forties. His preserved body offers unusually intimate evidence, but preservation also changes what investigators can measure. Drying, compression, recovery damage, and later storage must be separated from injuries he suffered while alive. Even a remarkably complete body is an altered archive. Place the discovery on the landscape: the Tisenjoch area, more than three thousand metres above sea level, in the high Ötztal Alps. The modern border is useful for finding the site. It cannot tell us his nationality. He lived thousands of years before these countries existed. Nor should we imagine an empty wilderness below him. Copper Age communities farmed, kept animals, made tools, and maintained contacts across difficult terrain. Ötzi carried products of that skilled world. His journey connects valley life with mountain routes, although the purpose of this particular crossing remains uncertain. Was he escaping trouble, travelling between communities, or doing something more ordinary before violence intervened? The equipment cannot choose one explanation by itself. Start with what the landscape can record. A traveller passes through different plant communities as elevation changes. Some of their traces enter the body. Pollen grains are tiny, durable structures. Under a microscope, their shapes can help specialists identify the plants that produced them, sometimes very precisely. But pollen is not a location tracker. Wind moves it. Food and water carry it. A useful interpretation needs ecology, context, and independent evidence.

title: Pollen and a changing landscape
voice: Cov kws tshawb fawb tshuaj xyuas tej seem nroj tsuag nyob rau ntau ntu hauv Oetzi txoj hnyuv. Lawv pom ib co cim ntawm tej chaw sib txawv. Qhov ntawd tsis yog ib daim ntaub ntawv uas sau txhua kauj ruam ntawm nws txoj kev. Cov lus txhais uas twb luam tawm qhia tias nws tej zaum taug ntawm thaj chaw qis muaj hav zoov mus rau thaj chaw siab hauv nws cov hnub kawg. Peb tsis paub txhua txoj kev uas nws tig. Ib hom hmoov paj pab txuas ib ntu ntawm txoj kev nrog hav zoov sab qab teb ntawm tej ncov roob. Tej nroj tsuag raws caij kuj qhia tias tej zaum nws tuag thaum caij sov pib, tsis yog thaum caij ntuj no tob. Ib lub cev hauv daus ua rau peb xav txog cua daj cua dub txias, tiam sis qhov chaw pom lub cev tsis yog pov thawj tias hnub nws tuag muaj huab cua zoo li ntawd. Thaum caij nplooj hlav los yog pib caij ntuj sov, saum roob siab tseem txias thiab txaus ntshai. Hauv hav tshav ntuj tsis txhais tias saum ncov tsis muaj cua hlob. Vim li ntawd, daim kev taug no yog lus txhais uas tseem yuav tsum sim ntxiv. Nws tsis muab teev tawm thiab teev tuaj tseeb. Ces muaj ib qho pov thawj ntxiv: qhov txhab tob ntawm tes xis, nruab nrab ntiv tes xoo thiab ntiv tes taw. Qhov txhab ntawd muaj thaum nws tseem ciaj sia, thiab ua ntej raug xub. Cov kws tshawb fawb xav tias yog ob peb hnub ua ntej, tiam sis tsis muaj sij hawm meej. Tej zaum raug thaum nws thaiv ib qho kev tawm tsam. Peb tsis paub leej twg pib, muaj pes tsawg leej, los yog lawv tau hais dab tsi. Yam paub txog kev siv tes yog yooj yim dua: tes mob ua rau nce roob, tuav cuab yeej, npaj zaub mov thiab kho khoom nyuaj dua.
source_voice: Investigators studied plant remains in different parts of Ötzi's digestive tract. Those samples offered a sequence of environments rather than a continuous recording. Published reconstructions suggest movement between lower, wooded terrain and higher alpine ground during his final days. They do not establish every turn he took. Hop-hornbeam pollen helped connect part of that journey to woodland south of the main ridge. Seasonal plant evidence points toward the warmer part of the year. That matters because the ice can mislead our imagination. A body found in snow did not necessarily die during a midwinter blizzard on a frozen continent. Spring or early-summer conditions can still be dangerous high in the mountains. Sunshine in a valley says little about wind and exposure on a ridge. The itinerary is therefore a working reconstruction. It gives us plausible movement through ecological zones, not a schedule with verified departure and arrival times. Now add the clue that makes this more than a story of difficult travel: a deep injury between the thumb and index finger of his right hand. The wound was sustained while he was alive, before the arrow injury. Researchers commonly place it in the preceding days, although exact timing remains approximate. A defensive injury is one interpretation. But an injury's position cannot tell us the words exchanged, the number of people present, or who began a confrontation. Picture the practical consequence instead. Climbing, gripping a shaft, preparing food, and repairing equipment all become harder when the dominant hand is painful or impaired.

title: The wounded hand and incomplete tools
voice: Txawm tes mob los, tsis yog txhua yam cuab yeej puas yuav qhia tias muaj neeg caum nws. Tej khoom siv kuj yaig thaum siv li niaj zaus. Qee qhov puas tom qab tus tswv tuag. Oetzi nqa ib rab riam pob zeb me, ib rab cuab yeej kho ntug pob zeb, rab taus tooj liab, lub hnab xub thiab ib daim ntoo uas tseem tab tom ua hneev. Ntau tus kav xub tseem ua tsis tiav. Ib daim ntoo hneev tsis tau npaj txhij tsis yog hneev uas siv tua tau tam sim ntawd. Muaj hnab xub kuj tsis txhais tias npaj txhij mus yos hav zoov los yog tiv thaiv tus kheej. Thaum tshuaj xyuas ntug cuab yeej pob zeb, cov kws tshawb fawb pom tias twb siv ntau lawm thiab tsis tshuav pob zeb tshiab ntau los kho ntxiv. Yog nyob deb ntawm qhov chaw muaj pob zeb zoo, kev paub kho cuab yeej tseem ceeb heev. Muab tes raug mob thiab khoom ua tsis tiav los saib ua ke, peb pom tias tus neeg taug kev muaj teeb meem ua neej tiag. Tiam sis tseem tsis tau ua pov thawj tias muaj ib pab neeg caum tom qab. Rab taus qhia lwm yam ntxiv. Kev tshuaj xyuas tooj liab txuas cov hlau ntawd nrog thaj chaw nyob deb sab qab teb hauv lub teb chaws uas niaj hnub no hu ua Ltalis. Qhov ntawd txhawb tias muaj kev sib txuas deb ntawm tej zej zog. Nws tsis qhia tias Oetzi tus kheej mus txog qhov chaw khawb tooj. Ib yam khoom muaj peev xwm dhau ntau tus neeg tes ua ntej los txog nws. Cov khoom qhia txog kev sib pauv, tsis qhia nws txoj hauj lwm los yog nws qib hauv zej zog. Vim li cas rab taus uas muaj nqis tseem nyob ze? Qhov ntawd ua rau peb nug txog kev nyiag khoom, tiam sis tsis qhia meej tus neeg tawm tsam lub siab. Peb yuav tsum nug tias tej cuab yeej pab nws ua tau dab tsi, ua ntej muab txhua yam hloov ua ib zaj dab neeg.
source_voice: That does not make every damaged tool evidence of a chase. Objects wear out in ordinary life, and some changes can happen after death. Ötzi's kit included a small stone dagger, a tool for retouching stone edges, a copper axe, a quiver, and an unfinished wooden bow stave. Several arrow shafts were unfinished. A bow stave is not automatically a ready weapon, and a quiver's contents do not guarantee immediate hunting or defence. Studies of the stone toolkit identified heavily used edges and a limited supply of workable material. Skilled maintenance mattered when fresh stone was not readily available. A wounded hand and incomplete equipment make a difficult combination. Together they support questions about his situation, but they still do not prove a pursuit. The axe adds another scale to the story. Analyses of its copper connect the metal with sources in what is now Tuscany, far to the south. That result indicates long-distance connections. It does not mean Ötzi personally travelled to the mine, or that we know every exchange along the way. An object can move through many hands. Its materials may reveal a network while leaving the owner's status, occupation, and personal itinerary unresolved. Why was such a valuable object still nearby? Robbery seems an incomplete explanation. Yet possessions left behind cannot establish the attacker's motive or identity. The temptation is to turn every object into a plot point. A better question is simpler: what could this equipment actually help a traveller do?

title: Clothing, warmth, and carried fire
voice: Nws cov khaub ncaws pab teb lo lus nug ntawd. Tawv tsiaj, plaub tsiaj, hlua cog thiab kev xaws zoo ua ke los tiv thaiv lub cev. Kev tshuaj xyuas tej daim tseem tshuav qhia tias siv ntau hom tsiaj, tsis yog ib daim tawv xwb. Cov khau muaj txheej sab nraud, ib daim vas sab hauv thiab nyom qhuav pab tuav cua sov. Peb saib daim duab xwb tsis paub tias khau ua haujlwm zoo npaum li cas, tiam sis pom tias cov neeg ntawd muaj txuj ci. Yam qhuav tuav tau tej qhov cua me me kom lub cev tsis poob cua sov sai. Thaum ntub lawm, txoj kev ua haujlwm hloov. Ib tug neeg taug roob yuav tsum saib xyuas ob qho: kom sov thiab kom tsis txhob ntub dhau. Taug kev ua kom sov tab sis siv zog thiab siv zaub mov. Thaum nres, raug cua los yog raug mob, yam khaub ncaws uas siv tau yav tas los tej zaum tsis txaus lawm. Nws kuj muaj tej thawv ua tawv ntoo. Tej seem ncaig thiab nplooj qhia tias cov thawv ntawd muaj peev xwm siv nqa hluav taws uas tseem kub. Qhov ntawd tsis ua pov thawj tias muaj hluav taws cig ntawm nws ib sab thaum raug tua. Muaj peev xwm ua tau ib yam txawv ntawm qhov peb paub tias tau ua lawm. Tej khoom me me no ua rau peb pom tus txiv neej zoo li ib tug neeg muaj sia: nws paub npaj qee yam, tab sis tseem raug kev phom sij. Yog xav mus ze dua nws cov teev kawg, yuav tsum nrhiav lwm hom pov thawj. Qhov ntawd nyob hauv nws lub plab. Thaum lub cev hloov, lub plab txav ntawm qhov chaw uas cov kws tshuaj xav nrhiav, ces siv sij hawm mam txheeb tau. Thaum kawm tau zaub mov hauv plab, lawv pom ib pluas uas muaj ntau yam. Nws tau noj mov ua ntej kawg, tsis yog nce roob thaum tsis tshuav zaub mov kiag li.
source_voice: His clothing answers part of that. Hides, fur, plant fibres, and carefully worked seams formed a practical system, assembled from different materials for different jobs. Genetic work on the surviving garments identified several animal sources. This was not a uniform costume made from one convenient hide, but a collection of choices. The shoes combined an outer structure, an inner net, and insulating grass. Their exact performance cannot be read from appearance alone, but the design is sophisticated. Insulation works by slowing heat loss. Dry material holds pockets of air; wet material behaves differently. A mountain traveller must manage both warmth and moisture. Walking produces heat, but it also demands energy. Stop moving, add wind, or become injured, and equipment that seemed adequate can face a different problem. His birch-bark containers carried another clever possibility: transporting embers. Charcoal and plant remains connect a fragile container with the practical management of fire. That evidence does not prove a fire was burning beside him at the moment of attack. Capability and action are different claims, even when a reconstruction looks convincing. These objects make him recognisably human: prepared in some ways, vulnerable in others. To approach the final hours, however, we need a more immediate record. The next clue was inside his stomach. Its unusual position in the preserved body delayed recognition, reminding researchers that ancient anatomy can be difficult to read. When investigators finally studied the contents, they found a substantial last meal. The dying traveller had eaten, rather than simply reaching the mountain in empty-handed desperation.

title: The last meal
voice: Cov tshuab tsom thiab kev tshuaj xyuas tej feem me ntawm zaub mov qhia nqaij tshis qus ibex saum roob, nqaij mos lwj, hom nplej einkorn thiab tej seem ntawm ib hom nroj tsuag fern. Cov roj tsiaj muaj ntau yog ib qho uas ntxim kawm heev. Roj muab zog ntau rau qhov hnyav tsawg, pab ib tug neeg uas yuav nqa mov thiab taug kev deb. Tab sis ib pluas hauv plab tsis yog keeb kwm noj mov ntawm tag nrho nws lub neej. Nws kuj tsis qhia tias txhua tsev neeg thaum ntawd noj zoo ib yam txhua lub caij. Tej seem nroj tsuag uas muaj tshuaj lom tsis qhia meej vim li cas nws noj. Tej zaum siv qhwv mov, nkag nrog mov yam tsis txhob txwm, los yog muaj lub hom phiaj kho mob. Kev kho mob tseem yog ib lub tswv yim xwb. Qhov zaub mov twb zom npaum li cas pab kwv yees tias nws noj tsis ntev heev ua ntej tuag. Tiam sis lub cev thiab hom mov ua rau kev zom txawv, ces ntsuas tsis tau teev meej. Muaj pluas mov loj tej zaum qhia tias nws tau nres. Tsis qhia tias nws xav tias nyab xeeb. Thaum muaj kev nyuaj, tib neeg tseem yuav noj thiab so. Peb daim kev taug tam sim no muaj cov ntu no: taug hauv hav zoov, tes mob, nce siab thiab noj ua ntej tuag. Qhov kev txuas ntawm txhua ntu tseem muaj tej qhov khoob. Peb tsis paub meej tias pluas mov yog ua ntej los yog tom qab raug xub, los yog nws txav mus deb npaum li cas tom qab. Kom kawm qhov ntawd, yuav tsum tig mus rau xub pwg. Xyoo ob txhiab ib, cov kws tshawb fawb txheeb tau lub hau xub hauv nws lub cev. Muaj qhov txhab nkag ntawm sab laug nraub qaum, siab ntawm xub pwg. Qhov ntawd yog pov thawj tseeb tias nws raug xub tua.
source_voice: Microscopy and molecular analyses identified ibex, red deer, cereals associated with einkorn, and traces of bracken. Different methods contributed different pieces to that reconstruction. The high proportion of fat was especially striking. In an active traveller's food, fat provides concentrated energy without requiring the weight of an equally energetic low-fat meal. This is evidence about a meal, not a complete dietary biography. One stomach sample cannot tell us what every Copper Age household ate throughout the year. Nor do the bracken traces settle their own purpose. Food wrapping, accidental ingestion, and possible medicinal use have been discussed. Deliberate treatment remains a hypothesis. The degree of digestion suggests he ate relatively shortly before death. But digestion depends on physiology and food, so it is not an exact stopwatch. A substantial meal can suggest a pause. It cannot tell us that he felt safe. People under pressure still eat, rest, and make practical decisions. Here is the first version of our timeline: earlier movement through wooded environments, an injured right hand, a climb, and food eaten before the end. The order is meaningful, but the gaps are large. We do not yet know whether the meal came before the arrow wound, or how far he moved afterward. To reduce that uncertainty, investigators turned to the shoulder. In two thousand and one, an arrowhead was identified in the body, transforming interpretations of his death. An entry wound lay on the upper left side of his back. The point had penetrated the shoulder region. This was clear evidence of an arrow injury.

title: The arrow and the survival debate
voice: Kev yees duab hauv lub cev tom qab qhia kev puas ze txoj hlab ntshav loj hauv xub pwg laug. Qhov raug mob no hnyav, tab sis yuav tuag sai npaum li cas tsis yog lus teb yooj yim. Tau ntau xyoo, ib zaj lus piav qhia nrov hais tias nws raug tua tom qab ces poob ntshav tuag sai. Qhov ntawd muab ib qho xaus meej rau zaj. Tiam sis ib txoj kev tuag uas muaj peev xwm tshwm tsis yog sij hawm ciaj sia uas ntsuas tau lawm. Xyoo ob txhiab nees nkaum tsib, ib pab kws tshawb fawb siv cov duab hauv lub cev los ua qauv peb sab. Lawv kawm qhov txhab, tej pob txha thiab cov ntshav uas tseem khaws nyob ib ncig ntawd. Lawv kwv yees tias cov ntshav khov ua ke ntawd muaj kwv yees ib puas kaum mililiv tom qab kho qhov hloov ntawm lub cev hauv lawv tus qauv. Qhov no tsis yog tag nrho cov ntshav uas nws tau poob. Lawv hais meej tias tseem cais tsis tau kev los ntshav sab nraud. Lub cev qhuav thiab raug nias kuj ua rau nyuaj txhais. Qhov tshwm sim ua rau tsis tsim nyog hais tseeb tias nws tuag tam sim ntawd, tab sis tsis tau daws tag nrho zaj. Lwm txoj kev tshuaj xyuas thaum kawg xyoo ntawd xav txog qhov txhab hauv lub xub pwg tseem ciaj sia, ua ntej cov nqaij qhuav thiab ntsws. Cov kws sau qhia tias kev txav ntawm cov nqaij tej zaum thaiv tau qee qhov ntshav tawm, thiab nws muaj peev xwm nyob ntxiv ntau teev. Thaum ntawd kev siv zog, qhov siab thiab qhov txias yuav tseem ceeb. Cov no yog lus txhais ntawm kev kawm, tsis yog daim yeeb yaj kiab uas rov pom yav dhau los. Peb yuav tsis hais tias nws tuag kiag tam sim, thiab kuj yuav tsis hais tseeb tias nws taug kev ntxiv ntau teev. Yog nws tseem txav tau, qhov chaw pom lub cev tej zaum tsis yog qhov chaw raug xub. Qhov txawv ntawd hloov peb txoj kev xav txog tag nrho thaj chaw.
source_voice: Later imaging linked the wound to damage near the left subclavian artery, a major blood vessel. The injury was serious; its consequences required closer interpretation. For years, a familiar explanation followed: a shot from behind caused rapid fatal bleeding. It was compelling, and it gave the case a dramatic final scene. But a plausible mechanism is not the same as a measured survival time. New analyses have returned to the scans and asked what the tissues actually show. A twenty twenty-five forensic study created three-dimensional models from earlier CT data. It examined the wound, surrounding structures, and a preserved collection of blood. The authors estimated roughly one hundred and ten millilitres for that reconstructed collection. Crucially, this was not a direct measurement of all blood he ever lost. They cautioned that external bleeding could not be excluded. Drying and compression also complicate reconstruction. The result challenged certainty about immediate death without solving the entire case. A separate clinical reassessment published later in twenty twenty-five considered how the wound channel would behave in a living shoulder, before the tissues shrank. It argued that movement of muscle could limit external bleeding and that survival for hours was possible. Exertion, altitude, and cold might then become important. These are research interpretations, not recovered footage. We should neither declare that he died instantly nor replace that certainty with a claim that he definitely walked for hours. The distinction changes the geography of the story. If he survived and moved, the place where the body was found might not be where the arrow struck.

title: A scene we cannot fully reconstruct
voice: Hauv xub pwg, txoj kev uas xub nkag kuj yuav tsum ua tib zoo txhais. Lub cev uas qhuav thiab raug nias tsis nyob tib yam li thaum tseem muaj sia. Cov kws tshawb fawb ua qauv txav pob txha los saib seb tej qhov txhab puas ncaj tau ua ke. Qhov ntawd pab nrhiav tej yam uas muaj peev xwm tshwm, tab sis tsis qhia txhua kauj ruam, qhov av nqes los yog qhov chaw tus neeg tua sawv. Tus neeg tawm tsam tsis muaj npe hauv tej pov thawj tshuav. Ib lub hau xub pob zeb tsis muaj tus tswv lub cim npe. Txoj kev xub tuaj tsis qhia nws lub hom phiaj. Tsis pom tus kav xub los kuj muaj ntau lo lus teb: tej zaum raug rho, tawg, hloov thaum lub cev txav, los yog puas tom qab. Yuav tsum xav txog ntau txoj kev ua ntej muab rau ib tug neeg qhov txhob txwm. Ua ib daim yeeb yaj kiab pom kev tua neeg zoo li tseeb yog yooj yim.
